reason: I'd use the free visit for sure, and if it's clean and my toddler likes it I'd probably pay for one more weekday visit. It's somewhere I could sit with a coffee and get a little done, but I wouldn't commit to a pass yet.
objection: It's a drive for us and gas adds up, so $13 plus gas for an hour or two has to be worth it compared to the free park or library. I'm not buying a monthly pass until I know we'd actually go every week.
would_change_my_mind: Reliable wifi and a seat where I can see my toddler while I work, or a cheaper rate for a small group from our church moms group.
